scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npx --yes concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
